question: What actually stands between 47 buildable families and 346?
answer: Source identity. 240 obligations across 119 families, and 167 of them do not yet have an official URL to fetch.

preservedFactoryLanes.rule: The thirty-two packet lanes are preserved. Nothing here rewrites PF01-PF16, FIX01-FIX04 or VF01-VF08, and SRC01-SRC04 keep their identifiers and take the reconciliation operation.

operations.handOff: ACQ, the moment an exact official URL is known — never at the end of the lane
PROMO where the byte is held and binds; DISC where the identity itself is wrong

never: accept a URL DISC has not settled
operations.handOff: PROMO, on the uploaded artifact and its receipt

never: release a family whose last source did not bind
operations.handOff: Captain, who assigns every released family to an available builder immediately

lanes.handOff: ACQ, the moment an exact official URL is known — never at the end of the lane
refusals: A source identity without an exact official URL is not settled. Record it STOPPED naming the office that publishes it.
NEVER guess a form number, a revision or a URL. A plausible address is worse than an absent one because ACQ will fetch it.
lanes.continueAfterFailure: An obligation that cannot be settled is one STOPPED row naming exactly what is missing. The lane continues to the next obligation. One failure never stops a lane.
